brief: The canvas displays a wooden open case placed horizontally. Coins, rendered as metallic yellow circles, slowly appear and drift down into the open space of the case. They accumulate at the bottom, piling up and gradually filling the container. The process is continuous and automatic, simulating the steady passage of time and the constant donations of passersby, making the case appear to fill with increasing volume and density.
prompt: a street musician's open case slowly filling with coins as people pass
statement: This sketch depicts a wooden case slowly filling with metallic coins that drift down from the top. The animation simulates the continuous passage of time and steady accumulation of donations, creating an ever-growing pile at the bottom of the container. The coins are rendered as golden circles with physics-based movement including gravity, friction, and bouncing off the sides of the case. The scene unfolds automatically without any user interaction, demonstrating how simple particle systems can create compelling, organic-looking behavior. The visual effect suggests a peaceful, ongoing process rather than a chaotic event, using only basic geometric shapes and color to convey both form and materiality.
